en.name: Boiled peanuts, shelled
en.summary: Shelled boiled peanuts are sold canned or in pouches in brine, which is what makes them a pantry item: about 3 years from purchase unopened. Once the can is opened they are a wet, cooked, low-acid food and keep only 7 days refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.
en.pantry: An unopened can or retort pouch keeps about 3 years in a cool, dark cupboard. That long life comes entirely from the commercial heat processing and the sealed container, not from the peanuts or the salt — which is why the figure evaporates the moment the seal is broken. Do not keep an opened can in the cupboard, and do not store cans somewhere hot or damp: a rusted or dented seam is the thing that fails, and a can that is bulging, leaking or hisses on opening goes in the bin unopened, not tasted.
en.fridge: Once opened, tip the peanuts and their brine into a clean covered container — not back into the can — and refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for up to 7 days. Keep them submerged in their liquid; peanuts left proud of the brine dry and darken at the top. Home-boiled peanuts are the same kind of food: a wet, cooked, low-acid item, so cool them quickly in shallow containers, refrigerate them promptly rather than leaving the pot to cool overnight, and eat them within a few days.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for boiled peanuts here. They do freeze, in their liquid, and will be safe indefinitely at −18 °C (0 °F) — but no published figure exists, so this page will not supply one. If you have boiled a large batch, freezing portions in their brine is a reasonable way to keep them, and the texture holds up better than you might expect because they are already soft.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight in their liquid, or reheat them straight from frozen in a pan with their brine until steaming hot. Never thaw on the counter.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or rusted can, or one that hisses or spurts on opening — discard without tasting.
Brine gone cloudy, ropy or foamy.
A sour, fermented or yeasty smell.
Sliminess on the nuts, or any mould at the surface of the liquid.
tips: Decant an opened can into a covered container; the can is not a storage vessel.
Keep the peanuts under their brine so the top layer does not dry out.
Cool home-boiled peanuts quickly in shallow trays, not in the pot.
Freeze a big home-boiled batch in portions with their liquid.

faq.q: How long do canned boiled peanuts keep?
faq.a: About 3 years unopened in a cool, dark cupboard; 7 days refrigerated once opened.

faq.q: Can you leave an opened can in the fridge?
faq.a: Transfer the peanuts and brine to a covered container instead. Keep them cold at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and eat within a week.

faq.q: How should home-boiled peanuts be stored?
faq.a: Cool them quickly in shallow containers and refrigerate promptly — they are a wet, cooked, low-acid food and should not be left to cool overnight in the pot.

zh.name: 去殼水煮花生
zh.summary: 去殼的水煮花生以罐頭或調理包形式浸在鹽水裡販售，這才是它能放櫥櫃的原因：未開封從購買日起算約 3 年。罐頭一開，它就是一份含水、熟製、低酸性的食物，冷藏 4 °C 以下只有 7 天。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭或殺菌調理包放陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 3 年。這段時間完全來自商業加熱殺菌與密封容器，而不是花生或鹽本身——所以封口一破，這個數字就蒸發了。開過的罐頭不要放回櫥櫃，罐頭也不要放在濕熱的地方：真正會失效的是生鏽或凹陷的罐緣，而脹罐、滲液，或打開時噴出來、發出洩氣聲的罐頭，請直接丟棄，不要試吃。
zh.fridge: 開封後把花生連同鹽水倒進乾淨的加蓋容器——不要留在原罐裡——放 4 °C 以下，最多 7 天。請讓花生保持浸在湯汁裡；露出液面的部分會變乾、變深色。自己煮的水煮花生也是同一類食物：含水、熟製、低酸性，所以要用淺容器快速降溫、盡快冷藏，不要讓整鍋在爐上放一整夜，並在幾天內吃完。
zh.freezer: 這裡沒有給水煮花生的冷凍期限。它確實可以連湯汁一起冷凍，在 −18 °C 下安全性是無限期的——但沒有公布的數字，所以本頁不會提供一個。如果你一次煮了很多，連鹽水分份冷凍是合理的保存方式，而且因為它本來就軟，口感的損失比你想像的小。
zh.thawing: 連湯汁冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接從冷凍連鹽水下鍋加熱到冒蒸氣。不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 罐頭脹罐、滲漏、生鏽，或打開時噴汁、發出洩氣聲——直接丟棄，不要試吃。
鹽水變混濁、牽絲或起泡。
聞起來發酸、有發酵味或酵母味。
花生表面發黏，或湯汁表面長霉。
tips: 開封後倒進加蓋容器；罐頭不是保存容器。
讓花生保持浸在鹽水裡，最上層才不會乾掉。
自己煮的用淺盤快速降溫，不要放在鍋裡涼。
一次煮太多就連湯汁分份冷凍。

faq.q: 罐頭水煮花生可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封放陰涼避光櫥櫃約 3 年；開封後冷藏 7 天。

faq.q: 開過的罐頭可以直接放冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 請把花生和鹽水倒進加蓋容器再冷藏，保持 4 °C 以下，並在一週內吃完。

faq.q: 自己煮的水煮花生怎麼保存？
faq.a: 用淺容器快速降溫並盡快冷藏——它是含水、熟製、低酸性的食物，不要整鍋放一整夜慢慢涼。
